name: AuraQoL
description: Quality-of-life HUD and tweaks, plus Hypixel SkyBlock helpers: blocks/s, price tooltips, a money tracker and a to-do list; and live Shadow Prison panels fed by that server's own data channel. Client-side; the only network use is reading public price data (Hypixel API, hysky.de) while on Hypixel, and the shadowprison:live channel on a Shadow Prison server that offers it.
